slides.say: You call set count three times, but the counter only goes up by one. Why?

slides.text: count is 0 in this whole render.
slides.say: Inside this click handler, count is zero the whole time. So each call says: set count to one.
Pass an updater function instead. React queues them, and each one receives the latest pending state. Now you get three.

slides.text: Rule of thumb: next state depends on previous state → use an updater.
slides.say: Rule of thumb: when the next state depends on the previous one, use an updater function.
